'''2000 San Diego Comic-Con Sealed Deck''' was a Star Wars CCG sealed deck held in San Diego Comic-Con, San Diego, California in July 2000. It is known from Tim Guzman's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1037">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-25-comic-con-open-2000d1037/ comic-con-open-2000], DeckTech (Tim "Info Broker" Guzman, 25 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-25-comic-con-open-2000d1037/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2000 San Diego Comic-Con Open]].

* '''Date:''' July 2000
* '''Site:''' San Diego Comic-Con, San Diego, California
* '''Format:''' [[Sealed Deck]]
